job.job_description:
Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy production-grade LLM-powered applications using LangGraph and LangChain. In this role, you will integrate enterprise LLMs such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or Anthropic, build end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on real-world data, and seamlessly integrate AI capabilities into web applications. Drive multi-file changes through Claude Code and review the output critically.

4+ years of experience in software development with strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience developing backend applications using FastAPI, asyncio, Pydantic v2, and pytest.
Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying LangGraph and/or LangChain-based applications in production environments.
Strong experience integrating and working with LLM APIs, including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or Anthropic, with a solid understanding of streaming responses, token usage, and cost optimization.
Hands-on experience building end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including document chunking, embedding generation, vector stores, retrieval strategies, and response evaluation.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Cline for multi-file code generation, refactoring, and productivity enhancement.
Strong SQL skills with experience writing analytical and performance-optimized queries.
Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, with the ability to integrate AI services into modern web applications.
Nice-to-have: Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure Cosmos DB.
Databricks.
OpenTelemetry
Vector DBs (Pinecone / pgvector)
